description.summary: protocol for relative pointer motion events

protocol.description: Vendored subset of wayland-protocols (unstable/relative-pointer). Delivers pointer motion deltas that are independent of surface position.

description.summary: destroy the relative pointer manager object

arg.name: utime_hi
arg.summary: high 32 bits of a 64 bit timestamp with microsecond granularity

arg.name: utime_lo
arg.summary: low 32 bits of a 64 bit timestamp with microsecond granularity

arg.name: dx
arg.summary: the x component of the motion vector

arg.name: dy
arg.summary: the y component of the motion vector

arg.name: dx_unaccel
arg.summary: the x component of the unaccelerated motion vector

arg.name: dy_unaccel
arg.summary: the y component of the unaccelerated motion vector
